::: {#def-simulation-mse-estimate}
#### Simulation estimate of the mean squared error

Let $\param$ be an [estimand](estimation.qmd#def-estimand), let $\hparam$ be an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator),
and let $T_1, \ldots, T_M$ be its [estimates](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) from $M$ [replications](#def-replication).
The **[simulation estimate](#def-simulation-estimate) of the [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-mse)** of $\hparam$
is the average of the squared differences $\paren{T_m - \param}\sq$:

$$\avgto{m}{M} \paren{T_m - \param}\sq.$$
:::
